verses.restored: Rejoice in YHWH, O ye righteous: for praise is comely for the upright.

familiar.text: Rejoice in the LORD, O ye righteous: for praise is comely for the upright.

modern.text: Rejoice in the LORD, O righteous ones; it is fitting for the upright to praise Him.

original.text: רַנְּנ֣וּ צַ֭דִּיקִים בַּֽיהוָ֑ה לַ֝יְשָׁרִ֗ים נָאוָ֥ה תְהִלָּֽה

verses.restored: Praise YHWH with harp: sing to him with the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings.

familiar.text: Praise the LORD with harp: sing unto him with the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings.

modern.text: Praise the LORD with the harp; make music to Him with ten strings.

original.text: הוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה בְּכִנּ֑וֹר בְּנֵ֥בֶל עָ֝שׂ֗וֹר זַמְּרוּ לֽוֹ

verses.restored: Sing to him a new song; play skilfully with a loud noise.

familiar.text: Sing unto him a new song; play skilfully with a loud noise.

modern.text: Sing to Him a new song; play skillfully with a shout of joy.

original.text: שִֽׁירוּ ל֭וֹ שִׁ֣יר חָדָ֑שׁ הֵיטִ֥יבוּ נַ֝גֵּ֗ן בִּתְרוּעָֽה

verses.restored: For the word of YHWH is right; and all his works are done in truth.

familiar.text: For the word of the LORD is right; and all his works are done in truth.

modern.text: For the word of the LORD is upright, and all His work is trustworthy.

original.text: כִּֽי יָשָׁ֥ר דְּבַר יְהוָ֑ה וְכָל מַ֝עֲשֵׂ֗הוּ בֶּאֱמוּנָֽה

verses.restored: He loveth righteousness and judgment: the earth is full of the goodness of YHWH.

familiar.text: He loveth righteousness and judgment: the earth is full of the goodness of the LORD.

modern.text: The LORD loves righteousness and justice; the earth is full of His loving devotion.

original.text: אֹ֭הֵב צְדָקָ֣ה וּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט חֶ֥סֶד יְ֝הוָ֗ה מָלְאָ֥ה הָאָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: By the word of YHWH were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.

familiar.text: By the word of the LORD were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.

modern.text: By the word of the LORD the heavens were made, and all the stars by the breath of His mouth.

original.text: בִּדְבַ֣ר יְ֭הוָה שָׁמַ֣יִם נַעֲשׂ֑וּ וּבְר֥וּחַ פִּ֝֗יו כָּל צְבָאָֽם

verses.restored: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as an heap: he layeth up the depth in storehouses.

familiar.text: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as an heap: he layeth up the depth in storehouses.

modern.text: He piles up the waters of the sea; He puts the depths into storehouses.

original.text: כֹּנֵ֣ס כַּ֭נֵּד מֵ֣י הַיָּ֑ם נֹתֵ֖ן בְּאֹצָר֣וֹת תְּהוֹמֽוֹת

verses.restored: Let all the earth fear YHWH: let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.

familiar.text: Let all the earth fear the LORD: let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.

modern.text: Let all the earth fear the LORD; let all the people of the world revere Him.

original.text: יִֽירְא֣וּ מֵ֭יְהוָה כָּל הָאָ֑רֶץ מִמֶּ֥נּוּ יָ֝ג֗וּרוּ כָּל יֹשְׁבֵ֥י תֵבֵֽל

verses.restored: For he spake, and it was done; he commanded, and it stood fast.

familiar.text: For he spake, and it was done; he commanded, and it stood fast.

modern.text: For He spoke, and it came to be; He commanded, and it stood firm.

original.text: כִּ֤י ה֣וּא אָמַ֣ר וַיֶּ֑הִי הֽוּא צִ֝וָּ֗ה וַֽיַּעֲמֹֽד

verses.restored: YHWH bringeth the counsel of the nations to nought: he maketh the devices of the people of none effect.

familiar.text: The LORD bringeth the counsel of the heathen to nought: he maketh the devices of the people of none effect.

modern.text: The LORD frustrates the plans of the nations; He thwarts the devices of the peoples.

original.text: יְֽהוָ֗ה הֵפִ֥יר עֲצַת גּוֹיִ֑ם הֵ֝נִ֗יא מַחְשְׁב֥וֹת עַמִּֽים

verses.restored: The counsel of YHWH standeth for ever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.

familiar.text: The counsel of the LORD standeth for ever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.

modern.text: The counsel of the LORD stands forever, the purposes of His heart to all generations.

original.text: עֲצַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה לְעוֹלָ֣ם תַּעֲמֹ֑ד מַחְשְׁב֥וֹת לִ֝בּ֗וֹ לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר

verses.restored: Blessed is the nation whose God is YHWH; and the people whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance.

familiar.text: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD; and the people whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance.

modern.text: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, the people He has chosen as His inheritance!

original.text: אַשְׁרֵ֣י הַ֭גּוֹי אֲשֶׁר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑יו הָעָ֓ם בָּחַ֖ר לְנַחֲלָ֣ה לֽוֹ

verses.restored: YHWH looketh from heaven; he beholdeth all the sons of men.

familiar.text: The LORD looketh from heaven; he beholdeth all the sons of men.

modern.text: The LORD looks down from heaven; He sees all the sons of men.

original.text: מִ֭שָּׁמַיִם הִבִּ֣יט יְהוָ֑ה רָ֝אָ֗ה אֶֽת כָּל בְּנֵ֥י הָאָדָֽם

verses.restored: From the place of his habitation he looketh upon all the inhabitants of the earth.

familiar.text: From the place of his habitation he looketh upon all the inhabitants of the earth.

modern.text: From His dwelling place He gazes on all who inhabit the earth.

original.text: מִֽמְּכוֹן שִׁבְתּ֥וֹ הִשְׁגִּ֑יחַ אֶ֖ל כָּל יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָאָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: He fashioneth their hearts alike; he considereth all their works.

familiar.text: He fashioneth their hearts alike; he considereth all their works.

modern.text: He shapes the hearts of each; He considers all their works.

original.text: הַיֹּצֵ֣ר יַ֣חַד לִבָּ֑ם הַ֝מֵּבִ֗ין אֶל כָּל מַעֲשֵׂיהֶֽם

verses.restored: There is no king saved by the multitude of an host: a mighty man is not delivered by much strength.

familiar.text: There is no king saved by the multitude of an host: a mighty man is not delivered by much strength.

modern.text: No king is saved by his vast army; no warrior is delivered by his great strength.

original.text: אֵֽין הַ֭מֶּלֶךְ נוֹשָׁ֣ע בְּרָב חָ֑יִל גִּ֝בּ֗וֹר לֹֽא יִנָּצֵ֥ל בְּרָב כֹּֽחַ

verses.restored: An horse is a vain thing for safety: neither shall he deliver any by his great strength.

familiar.text: An horse is a vain thing for safety: neither shall he deliver any by his great strength.

modern.text: A horse is a vain hope for salvation; even its great strength cannot save.

original.text: שֶׁ֣קֶר הַ֭סּוּס לִתְשׁוּעָ֑ה וּבְרֹ֥ב חֵ֝יל֗וֹ לֹ֣א יְמַלֵּֽט

verses.restored: Behold, the eye of YHWH is upon them that fear him, upon them that hope in his mercy;

familiar.text: Behold, the eye of the LORD is upon them that fear him, upon them that hope in his mercy;

modern.text: Surely the eyes of the LORD are on those who fear Him, on those whose hope is in His loving devotion

original.text: הִנֵּ֤ה עֵ֣ין יְ֭הוָה אֶל יְרֵאָ֑יו לַֽמְיַחֲלִ֥ים לְחַסְדּֽוֹ

verses.restored: To deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.

familiar.text: To deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.

modern.text: to deliver them from death and keep them alive in famine.

original.text: לְהַצִּ֣יל מִמָּ֣וֶת נַפְשָׁ֑ם וּ֝לְחַיּוֹתָ֗ם בָּרָעָֽב

verses.restored: Our soul waiteth for YHWH: he is our help and our shield.

familiar.text: Our soul waiteth for the LORD: he is our help and our shield.

modern.text: Our soul waits for the LORD; He is our help and our shield.

original.text: נַ֭פְשֵׁנוּ חִכְּתָ֣ה לַֽיהוָ֑ה עֶזְרֵ֖נוּ וּמָגִנֵּ֣נוּ הֽוּא

verses.restored: For our heart shall rejoice in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.

familiar.text: For our heart shall rejoice in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.

modern.text: For our hearts rejoice in Him, since we trust in His holy name.

original.text: כִּי ב֭וֹ יִשְׂמַ֣ח לִבֵּ֑נוּ כִּ֤י בְשֵׁ֖ם קָדְשׁ֣וֹ בָטָֽחְנוּ

verses.restored: Let thy mercy, O YHWH, be upon us, according as we hope in thee.

familiar.text: Let thy mercy, O LORD, be upon us, according as we hope in thee.

modern.text: May Your loving devotion rest on us, O LORD, as we put our hope in You.

original.text: יְהִֽי חַסְדְּךָ֣ יְהוָ֣ה עָלֵ֑ינוּ כַּ֝אֲשֶׁ֗ר יִחַ֥לְנוּ לָֽךְ
